第 19章 百年沧海桑田（第1页）
姜尤站在海滩上，遥遥看着已经不见踪影的巨木氏族。
巨木氏族在走之前，想要找姜尤“借”了一些族人，作为在在大海上航行的斥候。
但其实渡海而去，若是没有大部队一起，这些斥候要想再回来无疑比登天还难。
不过，姜尤还是找了一些族里天生具备冒险精神的年轻人，询问他们的意愿。
最终，有五十人愿意随巨木氏族远渡重洋。
临走之前，为了让这些年轻人不忘根本，姜尤为他们取了一个姓氏，并将翼人的族名提前套在身上。
于是这五十人以风为姓，远渡重洋，成为翼人一族的分支。
姜尤领着部族在这边海滨之地继续发展。
随着时间的推移，在泰坦之血的作用下，族人们的样子慢慢朝着姜尤所想的样子变化，他们的超凡天赋也慢慢提升。
此时外界的战争同样激烈无比，偶尔有逃亡来此的其他种族智慧生物给姜尤讲述着战争的情况。
不止泰坦巨人和太古巨龙伤亡惨重，费兰德万族更是直接消失了一半！
超凡者数量增加至数百名，在姜尤的引导下，一些专属于翼人的超凡职业出现。
比如天骑士，光明剑士，光之护卫，天空刺客等等。
不过，因为都是初代创造，这些职业的上限都不高，基本上都是职业第一阶。
唯有光明剑士在姜尤的帮助下，成为了上限为第二阶段的光明剑客！
姜尤也想将自己的职业传下，可惜族内没有光、雷两系的超凡觉醒者，只得作罢。
好在，这一代的光明剑士职业中，又一个年轻人天赋异禀，短短三十年便进阶第二阶，说不定将来能够拔高光明剑士职业的上限。

姜尤终于修行至圣翼行者的最后阶段，离传奇只差一步之遥！
这时的天堂山部落已经有了十万人！
除了天堂山作为翼人们的驻地之外，周围大大小小的高山上，都有翼人一族建立的村庄和小镇。
几乎所有的新生族人的模样已经和姜尤的身型差不多了。
历经百年，他们终于再也看不到曾经的鹰人模样，变得更像是小号的长着翅膀的泰坦。
姜尤召集全体族人到天堂山，正式宣布他们脱离鹰人一族，自立为翼人一族！
于此同时，外界的最新消息也传到了东海！
泰坦之王和太谷巨龙皇率领最后的族人在苍穹之原爆发最后的终战，几乎同归于尽。
战后，泰坦之王和太古巨龙皇不见踪迹。
一队身披厚厚毛皮衣物的地精骑着矮狼，走到了一处厚重的金属大门前。

> Chapter 19 A century of vicissitudes of life (page 1)
Chapter 19 A century of vicissitudes of life (page 1)
Jiang You stood on the beach, looking at the Jumu clan who had disappeared from a distance.
Before the Jumu clan left, they wanted to "borrow" some clan members from Jiang You to serve as scouts for sailing on the sea.
But in fact, if they cross the sea without a large army, it will undoubtedly be more difficult for these scouts to come back than to reach the sky.
However, Jiang You still found some young people in the tribe who were naturally adventurous and asked them about their wishes.
In the end, fifty people were willing to travel across the ocean with the Jumu clan.
Before leaving, in order to keep these young people from forgetting their roots, Jiang You gave them a surname and put the Yiren clan name on them in advance.
So these fifty people took Feng as their surname, traveled across the ocean, and became a branch of the Yiren clan.
Jiang You led the tribe to continue to develop on this seaside land.
As time went by, under the influence of Titan's blood, the appearance of the clansmen slowly changed towards what Jiang You wanted, and their extraordinary talents also gradually improved.
At this time, the war in the outside world was also fierce. Occasionally, intelligent creatures from other races who fled here told Jiang You about the war.
Not only the Titans and the Ancient Dragons suffered heavy casualties, but half of the people of Flanders disappeared!
The number of extraordinary people increased to hundreds. Under Jiang You's guidance, some extraordinary professions unique to wing people appeared.
For example, Sky Knight, Light Swordsman, Light Guardian, Sky Assassin, etc.
However, because they are all created in the first generation, the upper limits of these professions are not high, and they are basically the first level of professions.
Only the bright swordsman, with the help of Jiang You, became a bright swordsman whose upper limit was the second stage!
Jiang You also wanted to pass on his profession, but unfortunately there were no extraordinary awakeners of the light and thunder systems in his clan, so he had to give up.
Fortunately, among this generation of bright swordsmen, there is another young man with extraordinary talent. He has advanced to the second level in just thirty years, and may be able to raise the upper limit of the bright swordsmen profession in the future.
Jiang You has finally reached the final stage of cultivation as a Holy Wing Walker, and is only one step away from becoming a legend!
At this time, there were already 100,000 people in the Paradise Mountain tribe!
In addition to Tiantian Mountain as the base of the Yi people, there are villages and small towns established by the Yi people on the surrounding mountains, large and small.
Almost all the new tribesmen look similar to Jiang You's figure.
After a hundred years, they finally no longer looked like the eagle men they once were, and became more like small winged titans.
Jiang You summoned all the tribesmen to Tiantian Mountain and officially announced that they had separated from the Yingren Clan and established themselves as the Winged Clan!
At the same time, the latest news from the outside world also reached the East China Sea!
The King of Titans and the Dragon King of Taigu led the last of their clansmen to a final battle in the Plains of the Sky, and almost died together.
After the war, the Titan King and the Ancient Dragon Emperor disappeared.
A group of goblins wearing thick fur clothing rode dwarf wolves and walked to a heavy metal gate.
